task:
Zotero is installed and a pre-seeded library is at /home/user/Zotero/zotero.sqlite. Three PDF files are provided under /home/user/Documents/: attention.pdf, bert.pdf, deep_learning.pdf. Launch Zotero. Attach each PDF to the matching existing item as a child attachment (Attach Stored Copy of File):
  - attention.pdf -> 'Attention Is All You Need'
  - bert.pdf -> 'BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers'
  - deep_learning.pdf -> 'Deep Learning'
After completion, each of the three items must have at least one child PDF attachment. Leave Zotero running.

cli_feasibility.translation: Python script using SQLite + file operations: For each PDF-item pair: 1) Find item by title, 2) Copy PDF to Zotero storage directory with unique key, 3) Insert attachment item record with parentItemID, 4) Link attachment to parent item
cli_feasibility.reason: Multiple PDF attachments follow the same pattern as single attachment. Each attachment is an item in the database with parentItemID. A Python script can loop through the three files and create three separate attachment records linked to their respective parent items.
